steps.en: Staff records the offence in OCMS through the create notice screen
steps.id: Staf mencatat offence di OCMS lewat layar create notice

steps.en: Offence details are checked for all required fields
steps.id: Detail offence dicek kelengkapan field wajibnya

steps.en: The offence rule code is checked against the rule list
steps.id: Kode aturan offence dicek terhadap daftar aturan

steps.en: The system checks if the same offence was already recorded
steps.id: Sistem mengecek apakah offence yang sama sudah tercatat

steps.en: The system checks if the offence qualifies for an advisory notice
steps.id: Sistem mengecek apakah offence layak dapat advisory notice

steps.en: The notice is set up according to the vehicle type
The correct offence notice type is decided automatically
steps.id: Jenis notice offence yang benar ditentukan otomatis
steps.why_en: The notice type is picked by staff in the form and is not matched to the offence rule.
steps.why_id: Jenis notice dipilih staf di form dan tidak dicocokkan dengan aturan offence.

steps.en: Each notice gets its own unique notice number
steps.id: Setiap notice mendapat nomor notice yang unik

steps.en: The notice is saved and ready for the next stage
steps.id: Notice disimpan dan siap ke tahap berikutnya
